metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
metadata.article_title: Bar on jurisdiction of civil courts.

article.title: Bar on jurisdiction of civil courts.
article.content: Save as provided in sections 117 and 118, no civil court shall have jurisdiction to deal with or decide any question arising from or relating to anything done or purported to be done under this Act.
article.html:
162Bar on jurisdiction of civil courts.

Section 162 · Chapter XXI · page 120 of the Act

Save as provided in sections 117 and 118, no civil court shall have jurisdiction to deal with or decide any question arising from or relating to anything done or purported to be done under this Act.
